exposure: infection route (upper respiratory tract, genital tract)
outcome: maternal death due to invasive Group A Streptococcal (GAS) infection and toxic shock syndrome (TSS)
cohort: A total of 616 maternal deaths in Japan between January 2010 and March 2024, with a focus on 27 cases due to invasive Group A Streptococcal (GAS) infection and toxic shock syndrome (TSS).
finding: Most antepartum maternal deaths due to invasive Group A Streptococcal (GAS) infections originated from the upper respiratory tract, while puerperium cases were predominantly infected via the genital tract.
